summary: Frontend regression testing for mobile hero overflow fix + minor footer/chat label changes. Verified no horizontal overflow across landing and 5 secondary routes at 390x844. Desktop hero still large. Chat header shows Title Case 'Luchii Architect'. Footer Benchmarks/Safety hrefs are correct (/#benchmarks, /#safety) but page does NOT auto-scroll to the anchor after navigation (minor). /court page has no <footer> at all so footer-link-from-court test could not be executed as written.

integration_issues.flow: Footer hash anchors from another route
integration_issues.issue: Clicking Benchmarks (/#benchmarks) or Safety (/#safety) from /about navigates to landing with correct hash in URL, but the page does not scroll to the target section (scrollY stays 0; #benchmarks is at y=1974, #safety at y=6910). Needs a ScrollToHash effect in the router or Landing page.
/court page does NOT render <Footer /> at all, so Benchmarks/Safety links are not accessible from /court. If requirement is that footer must be present on /court, add <Footer /> to Court.jsx.

action_items: Add scroll-to-hash behavior on route change (useLocation hash effect) so /#benchmarks and /#safety actually scroll the landing page after navigating from another route.
Consider whether /court and /chat should include <Footer /> — currently they don't, so the 'links from /court' requirement cannot be met.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero fix works: h1 bounding box right=367.5 within 390 viewport at mobile; scrollWidth == innerWidth on landing and /court, /chat, /about, /ai-models, /luchii-code.
Chat header correctly rendered as 'Luchii Architect' (Title Case) with agent=architect query param.
Router lacks a ScrollToHash utility — hash links from Footer are ineffective for in-page scrolling on cross-route navigation.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4/5 requirement groups pass; footer-from-court not testable as /court has no footer, and hash scroll doesn't happen)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile overflow fix verified. Remaining items are minor UX — hash-scroll from cross-route footer links + missing footer on /court /chat. Focus regression on any layout changes; the specific numbers to check are documentElement.scrollWidth == 390 at 390px viewport and h1 right edge <=390.
